youtube_description:
Copper chromite is produced by thermal decomposition of one of three substances. The traditional method is by the uncatalyzed ignition of copper chromate.
Copper chromite is an inorganic compound with the formula Cu2Cr2O5 which is used to catalyze reactions in organic synthesis.
